baselineNativeRun.note: 2.20.93 Auto edit on the user's Sông Congo project, 2026-11-18; the reason for this release, not a measurement of it.

mockEvidence: Two sequences sharing one voice source end with one review set per workflow; manual, other-workflow and owned clip markers stay (#60).
Every tool marker is a point at the middle of its span; earlier range markers collapse on rerun and a second rerun makes zero writes; timeline hashes unchanged on 42 fixtures (#61).
Overlapping or touching same-kind warnings on one clip piece become one marker; voice and SRT markers at the same spot sit on adjacent frames (#64).

No path writes new ruler markers; caption-only mixed mode attaches to the first audible track with a covering clip; unattached warnings are reported; old owned ruler fallbacks are cleaned with restore on failure or Stop (#65).

changes: Review markers on a voice source replace earlier runs' review markers of the same workflow, across sequences (#60).
Tool markers are points (In = Out) at the middle of the warned span (#61).
Same-kind warnings that overlap on one clip piece share one marker; other kinds sit beside it (#64).
Ruler fallback markers are removed; warnings that cannot be attached to a clip are listed in the panel log (#65).
knownLimitations: Not verified in Premiere: point marker display on clips, whether a new marker already has end = start, the write-time saving, caption-only mixed-track attachment, and cleanup of the duplicate review sets and old ruler fallbacks.
On the first run after updating, a voice-alignment marker may sit one frame off if an old review marker occupies the midpoint; the next run moves it back.
Caption-only mixed mode attaches to the first audible track with a clip, which can be a music or SFX track.

Six Windows integration groups (installer lifecycle, rollback, panel registry, notification shortcut, native and incident notifications) were not run for this build; no clean-account install test or antivirus scan was recorded.
FFmpeg 8.1.2 source is not attached to the release; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md links to it (user decision 2026-11-15).
